pages.text: A $(item)Charging Point$() charges the electrics and Bullet Trains standing beside it (up to three blocks from the track; its cable reaches out over it). Feed it from BuildCraft engines or kinesis pipes: it stores a million MJ.$(br2)It charges a flat electric in ten seconds, and a timetabled train waits until it's full.
Its bars show its store; its lamp lights while it's charging.
Click it to see how much it holds. Redstone pauses it, and a comparator reads its store.$(br2)On a long line, $(l:electric/overhead_lines)overhead wires$(/l) keep trains charged as they go instead.
